note: CP-059 — the canonical RETURN line-type vocabulary, owned by PrepShip. Do not hand-edit: re-pin from upstream and let scripts/prepship-return-vocabulary-parity.mjs prove the copy.
why: The Client Portal's two summary authorities (billing-summaries.ts and reporting-metrics.ts) sum return money by line type. A spelling present upstream and missing here drops that money out of the return bucket while leaving it in grand_total, so a customer's invoice stops reconciling. Upstream says the same thing in its own doc comment on BILLING_RETURN_LINE_TYPES.
repinNote: CP-065 (2026-09-01): re-pinned past prepship-v4 PS-517, which moved the split spellings out of the predicate BODIES and into consts. exports.postage/.processing now name those consts, and the parity script reads all three buckets from their const declarations — so an upstream representation change can no longer read as a vocabulary change. Membership is unchanged from the previous pin.
